answer: Stake-weighted panels grade dossiers at random; a grader over one point from the median loses 30% of a 300-credit stake. Panels check dossiers against public logs: basalt analysis against the quarry log, lagoon reading against the harbour log. An honest grader stakes 300 credits once, refunded near the median. A sybil operator needs a separate 300-credit stake per fake grader, so the kth fake still locks 300 and 1,000 lock 300,000; a bloc loses 90 credits per deviating grader. A jade appraisal forgery ring fails because the guild register is public and honest graders pull the median back.
